source_note: Overall-expectation codes and titles verified live from the Ontario Ministry of Education's official Curriculum and Resources site (dcp.edu.gov.on.ca) for grades 1-8, September 2026. Wording of each overall expectation is stable across grades except Strand F1, whose exact phrasing progresses in depth across grades 1-8 (see the official grade page for the precise grade-specific wording); the description stored here is the general/most common phrasing. Kindergarten (2026) does not use these discrete strand codes; it is referenced against the 'Mathematics Continuum, Kindergarten-Grade 3 (2026)'.

overall_expectations.strand_name: Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) Skills in Mathematics and the Mathematical Processes
overall_expectations.title: Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) Skills and the Mathematical Processes
overall_expectations.description: Apply, to the best of their ability, a variety of social-emotional learning skills to support their use of the mathematical processes and their learning in connection with the expectations in the other five strands of the mathematics curriculum.
overall_expectations.note: Cross-cutting: applied and assessed through the other five strands, not taught or reported on as standalone content. Per ministry direction (2021-22 onward), SEL overall expectations are not formally assessed/evaluated/reported.

overall_expectations.title: Number Sense
overall_expectations.description: Demonstrate an understanding of numbers and make connections to the way numbers are used in everyday life.

overall_expectations.title: Operations
overall_expectations.description: Use knowledge of numbers and operations to solve mathematical problems encountered in everyday life.

overall_expectations.title: Patterns and Relationships
overall_expectations.description: Identify, describe, extend, create, and make predictions about a variety of patterns, including those found in real-life contexts.

overall_expectations.title: Equations and Inequalities
overall_expectations.description: Demonstrate an understanding of variables, expressions, equalities, and inequalities, and apply this understanding in various contexts.

overall_expectations.title: Coding
overall_expectations.description: Solve problems and create computational representations of mathematical situations using coding concepts and skills.

overall_expectations.title: Mathematical Modelling
overall_expectations.description: Apply the process of mathematical modelling to represent, analyse, make predictions, and provide insight into real-life situations.
overall_expectations.note: Has no specific expectations; it is an iterative process applied across strands and assessed through students' demonstration of that process, not as standalone skill content.

overall_expectations.title: Data Literacy
overall_expectations.description: Manage, analyse, and use data to make convincing arguments and informed decisions, in various contexts drawn from real life.

overall_expectations.title: Probability
overall_expectations.description: Describe the likelihood that events will happen, and use that information to make predictions.

overall_expectations.title: Geometric and Spatial Reasoning
overall_expectations.description: Describe and represent shape, location, and movement by applying geometric properties and spatial relationships in order to navigate the world around them.

overall_expectations.title: Measurement
overall_expectations.description: Compare, estimate, and determine measurements in various contexts.

overall_expectations.title: Money and Finances
overall_expectations.description: Demonstrate an understanding of the value and use of Canadian currency, and the knowledge and skills needed to make informed financial decisions.
overall_expectations.note: Exact wording deepens by grade: grades 1-2 focus on the value of Canadian currency; grade 3 adds use of currency; grades 4-8 progress to informed financial decision-making, budgeting, interest, and percentages applied to money.

kindergarten.effective: Beginning the 2026-27 school year (replaces The Kindergarten Program, 2016)
kindergarten.note: Kindergarten mathematics is not organized under the grade 1-8 lettered strand codes (A-F). It is referenced against a continuum document spanning Kindergarten through Grade 3, which the Ministry introduced alongside the new 2026 Kindergarten Curriculum.
